title: Installation & Setup
learning_objectives: Learn how to access PEGA Personal Edition
Navigate the PEGA interface for the first time

introduction.title: Getting Started with PEGA
introduction.text: Before you can start building PEGA applications, you need access to a PEGA environment. This tutorial will guide you through the different options available and help you set up your development environment. For beginners, we'll focus on the easiest and most accessible option: PEGA Personal Edition.

sections.title: PEGA Deployment Options
sections.content: PEGA offers several deployment options to suit different needs, from learning and development to enterprise production environments.

options.name: PEGA Personal Edition (Recommended for Beginners)
options.description: A free, cloud-based PEGA environment perfect for learning and experimentation.
cons: Limited to personal use and learning
Cannot be used for production applications
options.best_for: Students, beginners, individual learning, certification preparation

options.name: PEGA Cloud
options.description: Enterprise-grade cloud deployment managed by PEGA.
options.best_for: Enterprise production environments, organizations wanting managed services

options.name: On-Premises Installation
options.description: PEGA installed on your organization's own servers and infrastructure.
options.best_for: Large enterprises with specific security requirements, organizations with existing infrastructure

sections.title: Setting Up PEGA Personal Edition
sections.content: PEGA Personal Edition is the easiest way to get started with PEGA development. Follow these steps to set up your free account.

steps.title: Create a PEGA Account
steps.description: Visit the PEGA website and create a free account to access Personal Edition.
details: Fill in your personal information (name, email, etc.)
Verify your email address when prompted
tips: Use a professional email address if possible
Check your spam folder for verification emails

steps.title: Access Your Environment
steps.description: Once registered, you can access your personal PEGA environment through the web browser.
details: Log in to your PEGA account
Navigate to Personal Edition from your dashboard
Click 'Launch' to open your PEGA environment
Wait for the environment to initialize (may take a few minutes)
You'll be redirected to the PEGA portal
tips: Bookmark your PEGA environment URL for easy access
The environment may take time to start if it's been idle
Use a modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) for best experience

steps.title: Initial Environment Setup
steps.description: Configure your PEGA environment for optimal learning experience.
details: Complete the welcome tour if prompted
Set your user preferences (timezone, language, etc.)
Familiarize yourself with the navigation menu
tips: Take the guided tour to understand the interface
Don't skip the sample applications - they're great learning resources
Set up your profile with accurate information

sections.title: System Requirements
sections.content: Ensure your system meets the minimum requirements for optimal PEGA Personal Edition experience.

browser.title: Supported Browsers
notes: Chrome is recommended for best performance
Disable ad blockers that might interfere with PEGA

hardware.title: Minimum Hardware Requirements
notes: More RAM improves performance with complex applications
Higher resolution screens provide better development experience
Stable internet connection is essential for cloud-based Personal Edition

software.title: Additional Software
details: PDF viewer for documentation and reports
Text editor for external file editing (optional)
VPN client if accessing from restricted networks

sections.title: Navigating the PEGA Interface
sections.content: Once you have access to PEGA, it's important to understand the main interface components and navigation patterns.

interface_components.description: The top navigation bar provides access to main PEGA functions and user settings.
The main navigation menu for accessing different PEGA tools and applications.
The central workspace where you'll do most of your development and configuration work.
Side panels that provide additional information and tools based on your current activity.
elements: Property panels for editing object properties

sections.title: First Steps in PEGA
sections.content: Once your environment is set up, here are the recommended first steps to get familiar with PEGA.

recommended_actions.description: PEGA Personal Edition comes with pre-built sample applications that demonstrate key concepts.
steps: Run through a sample case from start to finish
Examine the case types and processes
Look at the user interface components

recommended_actions.description: Use PEGA's built-in guided tours to learn the interface and basic concepts.
steps: Look for 'Getting Started' or 'Tour' options in the interface

recommended_actions.description: Start with a simple application to understand the development process.
steps: Use the Application Wizard in App Studio

sections.title: Common Setup Issues and Solutions
sections.content: Here are common issues you might encounter during setup and their solutions.

solutions: Clear your browser cache and cookies
Contact PEGA support if issues persist
Ensure you have sufficient RAM available
Consider upgrading your hardware if consistently slow
Verify your account is properly activated
Check that you're using the correct login credentials
Contact PEGA support for access issues

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: PEGA Personal Edition is the best option for beginners and learning
No installation is required - it's completely cloud-based
Modern web browsers and stable internet connection are essential
The PEGA interface has consistent navigation patterns across tools
Sample applications are valuable learning resources
Start with simple applications and gradually increase complexity

next_steps.title: What's Next?
next_steps.text: Now that you have PEGA set up and understand the basic interface, the next tutorial will help you understand the differences between App Studio and Dev Studio, and when to use each tool.
